source.period: Per-post video performance compared February 2025 and February 2026, as specified in associated publisher press release; precise window for subscriber tier transitions not independently disclosed
source.sampling_frame: unspecified subset of observed accounts and videos; not a known random selection
source.population_definition: Accounts present in the provider's analysis

traffic_source_share_of_sampled_organic_.scope: all organic views in selected dataset

cross_format_association.limitations: Different cohorts may vary in maturity, upload effort, niche, subscribers and quality. Not a randomized controlled experiment; no causal Short-to-long-form lift established.

limitations: The provider's sample is not a platform-wide random channel sample and might skew toward active businesses or analytics-connected accounts.
Publisher press release names February 2025 versus February 2026 for per-post performance comparisons; detailed month-level tier-transition panel and selection/exclusion rules remain unavailable.
The reported tier-jump percentages are movements within the cohort, not probabilities that new creators will monetize or earn a living.
Traffic percentages concern organic view events observed in the sample, not unique people or total platform view share.
Subscriber tier, average video metrics and advertising earnings are not interchangeable units.
Year-over-year comparisons may reflect seasonality, changing account mix and platform metric revisions.
The cited report appeared before the August 24, 2026 YouTube view-count definition change; future comparisons must account for that structural break.
Observed correlation between Shorts frequency and long-form views cannot establish cause.
No measure of total creator profits, hours invested, nonparticipating channels, or realistic newcomer earnings can be inferred.
Published +127% Shorts raw public views from the vendor's February 2025/2026 cohort spans the March 31 2025 Shorts count-definition revision, so it is not comparable unchanged-event attention growth.
August 24 2026 all-format public-view revision took place after both reported February samples, not between them.
allowed_inference: Within this reported commercial analytics sample, compare reported cohorts and descriptive changes with explicit scope.
prohibited_inference: Treat this as representative probability of reaching any income level, a proven best publishing schedule or a platform-wide traffic census.
